repository_summary: Aspose.HTML FOSS for Python is an open-source Python library for parsing, inspecting, and manipulating HTML documents and DOM trees. It provides a lightweight, Pythonic interface to HTML parsing, DOM construction, serialization, URL handling, and CSSOM primitives, targeting developers who need programmatic HTML processing without external dependencies.
